title: Matching Algorithm Design and Short-Horizon Price Predictability in CME Futures
summary: One-minute OHLCV and aggregate NQ flow are not the MBO queue history; no positive source strategy case for a trial.
findings: Author abstract reports6.83billionMBOevents2025 and statistical predictability but upholds the no-economic-exploitability null.
mechanism: Microstructure predictability can be bid/ask bounce rather than earnable spread capture.
build_on: One-minute OHLCV and aggregate NQ flow are not the MBO queue history; no positive source strategy case for a trial.
code_feasibility: Not a profitable strategy specification from this evidence; queue-level research would need native MBO.
